title: Package 153 Scientific Independence and Indicator Field Assessment

question_1_surrogate_nature.basis: In Pandey & Kumar (2025) and throughout Thesis Gates 3, 4, 6B, Package 95, and Package 114, MISESERI is evaluated exclusively on an undamaged linear-elastic continuum model sharing the exact crack slit geometry and discretization. UEL phase-field elements do not support Abaqus native patch recovery. The companion model does not misrepresent phase-field damage, but provides the authentic Zienkiewicz-Zhu continuum stress recovery field.

question_2_step_and_displacement.basis: Static perturbation step to uy = 0.002000 mm corresponds exactly to the Stage C1-2 target continuation displacement. Linear elasticity ensures that relative spatial error distribution eta_e / bar_eta across all 7,056 elements is invariant under scaling, while matching the physical displacement scale.

question_3_field_output_validity.basis: Demonstrated empirically in Package 114 (Job 1417689), where Abaqus Standard produced authentic MISESERI, MISESAVG, EVOL, S, U, RF in the ODB in 2 seconds. Package 153 datacheck confirmed zero pre-processor errors and zero matrix singularities.

question_4_mesh_bijection.basis: All 7,056 CPE4 elements have identical labels 1..7056 to the C4 reference mesh. 40 duplicate slit-flank node pairs (3571..3610 and 7226..7265) and 45 ligament nodes (3611..3655) are strictly preserved with zero flank leakage.

question_5_dependency_nature.basis: Package 153 reads zero files from Package 152 (no restart, no ODB, no state vector). It is computationally self-contained. Evaluating Package 153 independently produces the authentic C4 error indicator distribution required by scripts/remeshing/c4_refinement_marking_interface.py without violating physical governance. Forward C4->C5 state transfer remains strictly conditional on accepted predecessor equilibrium.
